Guides / Start here / Beginner guide

Beginner guide

What Tallgrass is, your first hour and what each Gym badge unlocks.

Your first hourWhat each badge unlocksWhere to next

Tallgrass is an idle Pokémon hunt that lives in the corner of your screen. Your trainer walks the route, your team of 4 battles every wild Pokémon on its own, and your Catch rules decide which ones get a ball. You make the big calls: who's on the team, what to catch, which island to hunt, when to fight the Gym.

  1. 1Pick a starter

    Any of the 27 starters. Each has its own lucky roll: Shiny 1 in 16, Void 1 in 48, Prismatic 1 in 128.

  2. 2Let it hunt

    A wild Pokémon steps out every 14 seconds at first (faster with Sweet Scent). They also pile up while the game is closed.

  3. 3Fill the Pokédex

    Every new species pays money and raises your trainer rank: better Shiny odds and rarer spawns.

  4. 4Beat bosses, then the Gym

    A boss appears every 35 encounters (every 20 once the island's Pokédex is complete). Beat 6 on Dewleaf Town to open its Gym; the badge opens the next island.

  5. 5Watch for the rare ones

    Shiny, Void and Prismatic finds ring a bell and wait for you to battle them yourself, or let the team try.

Your first hour

  • Turn on auto-restock in Catch rules (it buys Poké Balls for you, $20 each) so you never run dry.
  • Spend early money on Sweet Scent (more encounters) and the Catching Charm.
  • Put two Pokémon of the same family (or a shared type, or anything with Ditto) in the Day Care: eggs hatch as you hunt.
  • Build a squad of 4: a DPS lead, a Break and a Support behind it. See Roles and Squads.
  • Give a teammate False Swipe or a sleep move: it becomes your Catcher and steps in so catches don't get knocked out. See Moves & the Move Tutor.
  • Your level cap is the next Gym's ace + 3. Stuck? Power up with Candy (Power-ups) or bring better type matchups.

What each badge unlocks

WhenUnlocks
From the startDewleaf Town, the Mart, catch rules and one Day Care pen
1 badgeRush charges and the next island, Sunny Shore · Quick Ball, Timer Ball, Repeat Ball, Dive Ball, Dusk Ball at the Mart · Held items at the Mart (role items from 2 badges, Leader items from 3 badges)
2 badgesLuxury Ball, Level Ball, Fast Ball, Heavy Ball at the Mart · Day Care pen 2 · Wonder Trade
3 badgesMoon Ball, Love Ball at the Mart · Mass Outbreaks (1 at a time) · the Battle Tower · the Night Market · Wild legendaries wake on islands whose Gym you've beaten
4 badgesDream Ball at the Mart · Day Care pen 3
5 badges2 Mass Outbreaks at a time · Raids (and receiving Legendary, Mythical, Void and Prismatic Pokémon in trades)
6 badgesBeast Ball at the Mart · Day Care pen 4 · the Poké Radar and Radar Charges at the Mart
8 badges3 Mass Outbreaks at a time · No more level cap: every badge is yours
